sourceAccessLimits: Actual author reads: all11 complete-family chunks and all13 selected older-body chunks were returned and read through EOF. The prepared plan remains prepared_for_inspection; this separate receipt records completed reads rather than equating capture with inspection.

All20 exact source/principal records,177 navigation labels,27 complete component records and four complete edited kanji bodies were read. All26 public metadata records and all captured public text were inspected. The101 older bodies are distinct;76 candidate bodies remain unselected.
The union contains268 complete families/703 senses, including18 principal families/35 senses. Twenty source rows map to15 new and3 reused identities: two rows reuse 計る and two rows share new はじめに.

26 public requests produced22 positive bodies and4 nonpositive records. Raw 剥す failed with HTTP404; canonical 剥がす succeeded. 始めに/初めに/はじめに responses have hashes but no selected lexical body and are not positive verification.

All positive public bodies derive from Digital Daijisen through Weblio: one dictionary authority, not independent reviewer retrieval, frequency evidence or native certification. Historical/mixed-heading content is separated from selected modern teaching.

Selective kana-primary articles recognize alternate Han spellings without changing their empty kanji arrays. Source 秤 and 斜 retain their actual primary characters despite missing cards; no new component cards are invented. 吐き気 retains 吐 metadata despite its missing card.

The existing 計る N3 article already explicitly teaches 測る/量る; sense1 has no spelling restriction requiring a teachingSpelling override. Existing titles/readings/primary metadata/exclusions/easier levels are preserved. はきはき gains only sourcedjlpt2; 挟む gains sourcedjlpt2 and the new comparison link.

Source and additional recognition senses are distinguished, not independently leveled. はじめに covers both source spellings with a qualified official-spelling distinction; raw blank or misleading source fields remain provenance.

Quiz safeguards are direct symmetric/nontransitive hypotheses, not an inherited clique or a global uniqueness proof. Category, shared English gloss and POS alone neither force nor excuse exclusions. Independent reviews have not yet run; inherited batch61 quiz debt remains deferred.

quizGuardRationale: 生える growth facets were compared directly with 育つ/成長/生長/伸びる/茂る and sprout noun 芽; a noun/verb difference is not automatically a safeguard exemption. Independent adjudication may reject an overconservative choice.

Peeling/removal guards do not equate every outer-cover removal with surface detachment. Sweeping and cleaning overlap directly; household sweeping does not inherit joint public 刷く painting or historical meanings.

ばからしい guards assess actual foolish/ridiculous/worthless secondary senses, not every negative adjective. 秤 is the weighing tool, not every measuring instrument; nausea is not just vomiting or general illness.

Gear/teeth/car-wheel associations do not alone imply quiz synonyms. Bucket/pail is a vessel, not every container. 挟まる/捕まる compares actual caught/trapped facets rather than spelling or transitivity alone.

はしご's ladder and venue-succession senses are separately taught; 階段 is a direct stairs/ladder comparison, not all elevating apparatus. はじめに's first/introduction facets are compared with actual first/beginning/introduction bodies.

はじめまして/宜しく protects a context-bound first-meeting greeting comparison, not identical unrestricted usage. 斜/斜め and directional 傾く were considered at the attested はす reading, not the broader しゃ compound family.
外れる assesses detachment, off-target and exclusion facets against actual 取れる/抜ける/ずれる/逸れる/外す bodies; the button example means undone, not necessarily torn off.

パターン's pattern/type/recurring behavior facets are considered directly against 模様/柄/型/形式/習慣/癖/傾向/縞, not all topic-adjacent design or behavior nouns. All guards remain independently reviewable author hypotheses.
sourceAccessLimits: Actual author reads: all11 complete-family chunks and all13 selected older-body chunks were returned and read through EOF. The prepared plan remains prepared_for_inspection; this separate receipt records completed reads rather than equating capture with inspection.

All20 exact source/principal records,177 navigation labels,27 complete component records and four complete edited kanji bodies were read. All26 public metadata records and all captured public text were inspected. The101 older bodies are distinct;76 candidate bodies remain unselected.
The union contains268 complete families/703 senses, including18 principal families/35 senses. Twenty source rows map to15 new and3 reused identities: two rows reuse 計る and two rows share new はじめに.

26 public requests produced22 positive bodies and4 nonpositive records. Raw 剥す failed with HTTP404; canonical 剥がす succeeded. 始めに/初めに/はじめに responses have hashes but no selected lexical body and are not positive verification.

All positive public bodies derive from Digital Daijisen through Weblio: one dictionary authority, not independent reviewer retrieval, frequency evidence or native certification. Historical/mixed-heading content is separated from selected modern teaching.

Selective kana-primary articles recognize alternate Han spellings without changing their empty kanji arrays. Source 秤 and 斜 retain their actual primary characters despite missing cards; no new component cards are invented. 吐き気 retains 吐 metadata despite its missing card.

The existing 計る N3 article already explicitly teaches 測る/量る; sense1 has no spelling restriction requiring a teachingSpelling override. Existing titles/readings/primary metadata/exclusions/easier levels are preserved. はきはき gains only sourcedjlpt2; 挟む gains sourcedjlpt2 and the new comparison link.

Source and additional recognition senses are distinguished, not independently leveled. はじめに covers both source spellings with a qualified official-spelling distinction; raw blank or misleading source fields remain provenance.

Quiz safeguards are direct symmetric/nontransitive hypotheses, not an inherited clique or a global uniqueness proof. Category, shared English gloss and POS alone neither force nor excuse exclusions. Independent reviews have not yet run; inherited batch61 quiz debt remains deferred.
